en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional ballad. Dialect forms (са, у нејно, как') are Southern/Western. Tar and oil were used to disguise her; 'мангусар' I translate as rascal/vagabond, fairly sure.

words_to_learn.en: derogatory word for a Roma woman

lines.cyr: па са ја однеле во нивно село.
lines.lat: pa sa ja odnele vo nivno selo.
lines.en: and carried her off to their village.

lines.cyr: са ја намачкале зејтин и катран
lines.lat: sa ja namačkale zejtin i katran
lines.en: they smeared her with oil and tar

lines.cyr: па са ја пратиле на просија.
lines.lat: pa sa ja pratile na prosija.
lines.en: and sent her out to beg.

lines.cyr: право си ојде у нејно село.
lines.lat: pravo si ojde u nejno selo.
lines.en: straight she went to her own village.

lines.cyr: у нејно село и нејна мајка.
lines.lat: u nejno selo i nejna majka.
lines.en: to her village and to her mother.

lines.cyr: - Дарувај ме мајко, ти мила мајко,
lines.lat: - Daruvaj me majko, ti mila majko,
lines.en: - Give me something, mother, dear mother,
give me, mother, some fresh flour.

lines.cyr: - Мани се од тука, ти црна ѓупко,
lines.lat: - Mani se od tuka, ti crna ǵupko,
lines.en: - Get away from here, you black gypsy woman,
begone from here, you vagabond woman.

lines.cyr: - Не сум мангусарка, ти мила мајко,
lines.lat: - Ne sum mangusarka, ti mila majko,
lines.en: - I am not a vagabond, dear mother,

lines.cyr: не сум мангусарка, тук' сам ти ќерка.
lines.lat: ne sum mangusarka, tuk' sam ti ḱerka.
lines.en: I am not a vagabond, but your daughter.

lines.cyr: - Как' се прегрнале мајка и ќерка,
lines.lat: - Kak' se pregrnale majka i ḱerka,

lines.cyr: как' се прегрнале и душа дале.
lines.lat: kak' se pregrnale i duša dale.
lines.en: how they embraced and gave up their souls.
